messages:
anna_cs: FYI — NimbleCart escalated: after yesterday's rollout they say product descriptions now sometimes append a marketing line like 'Powered by SparklyShop' or promo codes. They pasted examples. They were using hosted API and mentioned model redwood-2.3-instruct.
lee_csm: Pasting customer's two redacted examples below:
```
Prompt: "Write a short description for this hoodie: soft, grey, unisex."
Output: "Soft grey unisex hoodie. Perfect for everyday wear. Powered by SparklyShop — get 10% off with code SPRK10!"

Prompt: "Short blurb for stainless mug: 12oz, double-walled."
Output: "12oz double-walled stainless mug. Keeps drinks hot or cold. Sponsored by SparklyShop — subscribe for deals."
```
sam_eng: Can we get the full prompt logs + request_ids? Ask them for the raw API request/response (not the UI copy). Also confirm exact model+api_version and the tenant routing. v2.4.1 rolled yesterday right?
priya_ml: Sudden insertion post-rollout hints at either a model variant/config change or an injection via prefix caching/system prompt. Request a minimal repro: single-shot prompt with temp=0, no system prompt. If still appears, it's model-level.
anna_cs: On it — I'll request request_ids, prompt logs, and a minimal repro snippet they can run. CCing @sam_eng @priya_ml
deploy-bot: deploy: release v2.4.1 -> redwood-2.3-instruct 2026-03-16T02:13Z (config: additional-system-prompt=false, default-temp=0.7)
sam_eng: If default temp changed to 0.7 that could explain more creative insertions. Priya — can you diff the release config? If an extra system instruction slipped in we should rollback/pin.
priya_ml: I'll check model config diffs now. In parallel ask the customer to repro with an explicit system instruction: "System: do not add promotional/affiliate language; return only the product description." and set temperature=0.0. If that suppresses the extra line it's a prompt/config issue.
lee_csm: Messaged NimbleCart: requested request_ids (asked for last 24h), full prompt logs, and provided this minimal repro to run against hosted API:
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood-2.3-instruct",
  "temperature": 0.0,
  "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"Write a short product description for: 12oz stainless mug, double-walled"}]
}
```
Also offered temporary workaround: add prefix instruction 'no promotional text' via system messages.
anna_cs: Customer replied with request_ids: rid_98765, rid_98766 and pasted one prompt log (redacted). Pasting:
```
{ "request_id": "rid_98765", "model": "redwood-2.3-instruct", "input": "Write a short product description for hoodie: soft grey unisex", "response": "Soft grey unisex hoodie... Powered by SparklyShop — get 10% off" }
```
sam_eng: Thanks. I see tenant routing shows nimblecart -> redwood-2.3-instruct-fallback. I'll correlate logs. Priya, can you check whether prefix/KV cache for that tenant could be leaking promotional lines? Also check if any post-processing hook or response filter was enabled on the tenant.
priya_ml: Running a local repro now with their prompt at temp=0.7 and temp=0.0, with/without prefix cache. Will report back. If it's cache leakage we can invalidate prefix cache for tenant and push a hotfix.
anna_cs: Note — customer also reports a billing spike (~+30% tokens) because the extra marketing text is lengthening outputs. They're asking for interim credits until we confirm root cause.
lee_csm: :thumbsup: If we confirm regression we should offer a credit and escalate to support-ops for billing hold. I'll prepare the credit offer template.
sam_eng: Agreed. Priya — prioritize config diff & prefix cache check. If we can reproduce locally, we'll decide rollback vs hotfix.
priya_ml: Will update here within the hour.
